item.title: Stephen Bulger Gallery is pleased to announce the representation...
item.description: Stephen Bulger Gallery is pleased to announce the representation of Melissa Auf der Maur..Before becoming the bassist for ‘9s alternative rock bands Hole and, later, the Smashing Pumpkins, Montreal-born Melissa Auf der Maur studied photography at Concordia niversity. She maintained her daily practice while on the road, requesting a roll of 35mm film at every venue as part of her rider and resulting in over 1, images documenting life onstage and away from the crowds. A major exhibition of Auf der Maur’s photographs is on view at the Art Gallery of Ontario from September 8, 6, and is accompanied by a hardback photobook that includes over of the musician’s photographs, co-published by the AGO and DelMonico Books.Auf der Maur’s photographs have been featured in publications including National Geographic and Spin, among others. In 1 she cofounded the nonprofit arts and performance center Basilica Hudson, located in upstate New York. This past March, Auf der Maur published Even the Good Girls Will Cry: A '9s Rock Memoir..Visit our website for more information.Reaching for a Yellow Field, SA, 1999 © Melissa Auf der Maur / courtesy Stephen Bulger GallerySelf-Portrait in Reflection of a Zenith Television, SA, 1998 © Melissa Auf der Maur / courtesy Stephen Bulger GalleryCourtney on Tarmac, cross-processed film, Europe, 1999 © Melissa Auf der Maur / courtesy Stephen Bulger GalleryRoom Service Tray, First Cell Phone, Blockbuster CD Case, Canada, 1999 © Melissa Auf der Maur / courtesy Stephen Bulger GallerySelf-Portrait with Red Light, Smashing Pumpkins Farewell Tour, Europe, Summer, © Melissa Auf der Maur / courtesy Stephen Bulger Gallery

item.title: Bassist, singer, and photographer Melissa Auf der Maur spent the...
item.description: Bassist, singer, and photographer Melissa Auf der Maur spent the ‘9s touring the world with iconic rock bands Hole and The Smashing Pumpkins before launching her solo career. Alongside her numerous multidisciplinary achievements, @xmadmx is co-founder of @BasilicaHudson, a landmark performance venue in New York.Her new album, ‘BASS WOMB ROOM: My ’9s 4-Track Demos x Field Recordings’ is out now via Envision Records. Auf der Maur wrote the demos in her living room studio in the 199s on her trusted Tascam 4-track, using lo-fi tricks such as flipping the cassette backwards and pitch shifting. Her field recordings captured mundane everyday sounds, transforming them into something unmistakably beautiful.To celebrate the release, she shared 5 of her favorite records.#5RecordsWithDiscogs

item.description: This NOV. 5: two Hudson friends who shaped and documented defining eras of rock'n'roll lead a conversation about music, memory, and creative community!Former bassist of seminal ‘9s rock bands Hole and The Smashing Pumpkins and Basilica Hudson co-founder Melissa Auf der Maur joins artist and director Michael Lindsay-Hogg to discuss two extraordinary chapters of music history, followed by a Q&A, book signing, and reception with music by DJBNNYBRNS.Celebrating her 6 memoir, Even the Good Girls Will Cry, and companion photo book, My ’9s Rock Photographs, Auf der Maur shares stories from alternative rock’s ‘9s heyday alongside Lindsay-Hogg, whose work with The Beatles and The Rolling Stones includes Let It Be and The Rolling Stones Rock and Roll Circus. ️ Tickets Available Now + Books for SaleThursday, Nov. 5, 6 | 6: PM
